releaseStageRevision.policy: Source quality, migration-history comparisons and browser tests run in PR quality workflows. Release runs tag/source checks, builds and validates artifacts, and publishes them.
releaseStageRevision.notes: Existing local measurements and previous Actions records above are preserved. The earlier projected runtime release increase of 1-3 minutes no longer applies; the current workflow also removes 113 seconds of source checks from the previous recorded release workflow.

duplicateGateMeasurements.notes: Reuses existing CI jobs and npm ci; no browser or release steps added. The first parallel full runtime run hit an existing checkpoint compression test 5s timeout. Its focused 11 tests and subsequent complete ci:checks passed unchanged when run separately. Cloud overhead including platform-package download is not yet measured.
